name: Roy Russo
summary: An experimental study of ADHD traits, repeated trading, and performance in a simulated market. The focus is on observed behavior under standardized conditions rather than self-reported investment behavior.

name: Eden Silne
topic: Secondary traumatic stress and vicarious growth
summary: Examines cognitive, interpersonal, and personal factors in mental health professionals’ responses to working within a shared traumatic reality, including rumination and client-inspired hope.

name: Shachar Bitton
summary: Examines spillover and crossover following secondary traumatic stress among Israeli therapists and their partners, with attention to the role of invalidation.

name: Amit Lavie
summary: Studies antisemitic experiences in international work interactions, organizational commitment, burnout, and perceived organizational support among employees in Israel.

name: Sahar Shmueli
topic: Sibling relationships in the context of PTSD
summary: Evaluates a six-session intervention for adult siblings when one sibling is coping with PTSD. A nonrandomized controlled pre–post design examines both relationship quality and individual wellbeing.

name: Thomas Grabiak
summary: A systematic review and meta-analytic thesis examining the relationship between antisemitism and psychological health.

name: Andrea Ormaza
summary: Examines longitudinal relationships between discrimination and wellbeing among adolescents in Germany, including the role of social support.
